item.title: Members of MM i have an announcement to make. Our Policy of scamming is strictly zero tolerable if you are caught scamming you will be removed from ALL MM Groups, Activites, Events, you also will be banned from the website. and If the Scaming Issue involves money or relates to it. It shall be reported to local authoritys. Also some tips on how to avoid scams Don't fall anything, don't trust anyone don't lend items out, also make sure they pay/trade you what you agree on in the same TRADE none of this "Hey, Lemme borrow earbuds and ill give you 24 keys tmmrw". What we advise is to wait and make sure your items are safe till you have made a complete trade that is fair and equal and no one gets ripped off from it.

item.title: Donations
item.description: Do you love this community? Do you enjoy chatting with all your buds online? Then scrounge up 5 bucks and donate! It's fast, secure, and easy! We are not all made of money, and we understand that. However, stuff costs money, and if it's you not paying the price, it means someone else is. Thanks to the few of you who have donated(Knight Errant, Paper Salad, etc.) You have helped keep the community alive! And to everyone else, feel free to pitch in as well!
